title: Second Renaissance Wikia
source_claim_or_role: Poll option asks what a book should cover; no lore assertion.
proposed_disposition: Exclude from lore dependency set; retain page unchanged.

title: Timeline of major events
source_claim_or_role: Sets 2026 seven-metre rise and links 2041 near-30m curve, famine, revolution and China war.
proposed_disposition: Replace the Flood chronology and re-author dependent timeline rows; preserve the original as Bronze evidence.

title: 21st Century
source_claim_or_role: Lists the Flood among defining 21st-century events without its own causal account.
proposed_disposition: Remove or replace the event in the century summary after the detailed chronology is reconciled.

title: Dylan J. Price
source_claim_or_role: California disaster and failed relief are cited as the reason Price ran for governor in 2026.
proposed_disposition: Re-ground the political decision in plausible California-specific conditions; do not preserve the global Flood premise.

title: World War III
source_claim_or_role: Flood-linked ecological damage and large-scale British population relocation shape the postwar settlement.
proposed_disposition: Rebuild migration and British political/economic conditions from independent causes; quantify any retained movement.

title: United States of America
source_claim_or_role: Flood section connects ice-sheet loss to labor shortage, 2027 crash, federal power, migration and population geography.
proposed_disposition: Major rewrite: retain only individually plausible policies and regional hazards with separate causal chains.

title: The Flood
source_claim_or_role: Defines 300m deaths, 7m rise, 2.4bn displaced, 11m initial deaths and near-30m peak; also separately says 300m lacked basic needs in China.
proposed_disposition: Retire the global event model and extreme totals; keep the two distinct 300m claims distinct in the audit record.

title: Market Crash of 2027
source_claim_or_role: Flood evacuation, recovery and insurance losses contribute to the crash narrative.
proposed_disposition: Crash remains optional; rebuild its trigger/transmission without relying on the Flood or mass evacuation.

title: United Federation of China
source_claim_or_role: Flood is stated to worsen Chinese instability and drive inland migration/cultural change.
proposed_disposition: Remove Flood as a national-scale trigger; independently reconstruct migration and political developments.

title: Revolutions of 2027
source_claim_or_role: Regional famine, displacement and instability are attributed to the Flood and feed a global revolutionary wave.
proposed_disposition: Remove synchronized global wave; preserve only independently evidenced regional political processes.

title: Carla Anderson
source_claim_or_role: Biography assumes Commonwealth populations were largely resettled in North America during the Flood.
proposed_disposition: Rebuild the population/resettlement background independently; personal biography is not itself proof of Flood causality.

title: First Nations War
source_claim_or_role: Infobox places war within 'Climate Wars'; EWG solar-reflector conflict is tied to environmental devastation attributed to the Flood.
proposed_disposition: Post-2041 war may remain as divergence, but replace the inherited Flood/refreeze causal chain and explain regional actors.

title: Japan
source_claim_or_role: Flood pressure is used to explain Japanese constitutional/military changes and territorial expansion.
proposed_disposition: Re-ground each policy and territorial action in Japanese domestic politics, security threats and regional strategy.

title: Trump-Russia scandal
source_claim_or_role: Says media about the scandal fell out of vogue during the early Flood; no event mechanism depends on it.
proposed_disposition: No structural dependency; revise only if the Flood era label is removed from surrounding chronology.

title: Augment Rights Movement
source_claim_or_role: Uses 'Flood Generation' as a demographic/cultural cohort and links its naturalist attitudes to climate effects.
proposed_disposition: Rename/redefine the cohort using a plausible demographic marker; preserve social claims only if independently grounded.

title: Genetic Engineering
source_claim_or_role: Public acceptance, crop engineering and fish modifications are attributed to Flood/Famine pressures.
proposed_disposition: Retain plausible agricultural biotechnology only with independent food-security and regulatory drivers; remove implausible emergency leap.

title: Earth Working Group
source_claim_or_role: Large restoration, New Tokyo, ocean dredging and polar interventions are framed as responses to Flood damage.
proposed_disposition: Rebuild as bounded, technically and financially plausible programs; remove global coast restoration and polar-scale reversal assumptions.

title: American colonization of Mars
source_claim_or_role: Flood-triggered Luddite movement changes public support for Mars terraforming.
proposed_disposition: Mars program is separately retired; if any later program remains, give opposition independent environmental/political causes.

title: Israel
source_claim_or_role: Rising seas flood the Jordan Valley and change Israeli agricultural/foreign-policy priorities.
proposed_disposition: Remove global Flood premise; retain water scarcity, drought, basin management and regional security as independent pressures.

title: Postnaturalism
source_claim_or_role: Flood is described as the pivot that made geoengineering an accepted conservation tool.
proposed_disposition: Re-ground ideological change in accumulated climate impacts, industrial accidents, scientific debates and specific policies.

title: European Union
source_claim_or_role: Flood is credited with an EU support resurgence; Market Crash then weakens member economies.
proposed_disposition: Separate EU political/economic trends from the impossible global Flood shock; retain only independently plausible developments.

title: United Nations
source_claim_or_role: North Korean government collapse and UN stabilization operations are attributed to Flood-related internal strife.
proposed_disposition: Replace with a distinct Korean domestic/security trigger if the later transition is retained.

title: Seventh Party System
source_claim_or_role: Flood and labor shortage are central to party-system realignment, immigration and foreign-policy narrative.
proposed_disposition: Rebuild the realignment from elections, institutions, polarization, labor/demographic shifts and policy coalitions; no global Flood catalyst.

title: Poll archive
source_claim_or_role: Flood appears only as an option in a community poll.
proposed_disposition: Exclude from lore dependency set; retain unchanged.

title: Caribbean annexation
source_claim_or_role: Caribbean-wide evacuation and refugee flows are tied to Greenland calving and rising seas, alongside recurring hurricanes.
proposed_disposition: Remove total-evacuation/global-Flood framing; consider bounded hurricane, storm-surge, insurance and migration cases by island.

title: Mexico
source_claim_or_role: Explicitly says Mexico was not severely affected by the Flood; separately cites northern drought and Mexico City flooding.
proposed_disposition: Keep only independently plausible regional drought/flood risk; remove the global event label and avoid treating this as a causal Flood dependency.

title: Third Chinese Civil War
source_claim_or_role: Post-2105 narrative says Flood displaced millions inland; Refreeze later returned coastal land and shaped migration/economic growth.
proposed_disposition: Preserve as a later unresolved continuity issue; remove dependence on impossible Flood/Refreeze geography and independently explain internal migration.

title: Second Chinese Civil War
source_claim_or_role: War background points to Flood; narrative ties 100m displacement/food pressure and Three Gorges Dam failure to rebellion.
proposed_disposition: Remove 2027–2048 civil war, dam catastrophe and Flood-driven displacement under the approved timeline.

title: Argentina
source_claim_or_role: Río de la Plata damage is said to cause severe contraction and later reconstruction.
proposed_disposition: Re-ground economic contraction in Argentina-specific fiscal, trade, commodity, political and hydrological conditions; do not attribute it to a global Flood.

title: India
source_claim_or_role: Flood famine triggers Pakistan civil war, refugee flows, Kashmir uprising and Indian military response.
proposed_disposition: Remove the chain as written; any South Asian conflict must have independent proximate causes and realistic scale.

title: Quebec
source_claim_or_role: Greenland event and flooding of the Laurentian Plateau are said to drive economic damage, abandonment grievance and independence referendum.
proposed_disposition: Remove impossible sea-level mechanism; if separatism remains, use credible constitutional, fiscal, linguistic and federal-provincial causes.

title: List of recessions in the United States
source_claim_or_role: The 2043 Summer of Storms, linked to The Flood, ends a later growth period and contributes to recession.
proposed_disposition: Because this is post-2041, it may be divergent; detach the storm from the pre-2041 Flood and specify an independent event.

title: The Refreeze
source_claim_or_role: 2045 geoengineering is explicitly initiated in response to Flood effects and aims to restore pre-Anthropocene climate/sea levels.
proposed_disposition: Post-2041 divergence is permitted, but replace impossible global reversal with bounded, technically credible climate intervention or remove it.

title: Great Reset
source_claim_or_role: Flood intensifies racialized refugee politics, labor shortages, unrest, famine and rebuilding pressures.
proposed_disposition: Retain independently supported structural pressures; remove Flood as master catalyst and avoid one-event deterministic reset.

title: Arctic states
source_claim_or_role: Arctic polities and refugee settlement are formed amid Eurasian/North American Flood displacement; later EWG conflict also follows.
proposed_disposition: Rebuild any post-2041 Arctic political formation from migration, resource governance, indigenous autonomy and security; no 2bn-scale global displacement.

title: Canada
source_claim_or_role: Flood-era refugee influx is described as Canada's main economic strain; later Commonwealth occupation and constitutional developments follow.
proposed_disposition: Replace mass refugee premise with plausible migration and domestic political/economic drivers; audit occupation claims separately.

title: British Republic
source_claim_or_role: Flood and Revolutions are cited as causes of the British Republic; US-administered mass resettlement follows.
proposed_disposition: Remove catastrophic cause and re-ground constitutional transition, state capacity and migration in independent UK/European developments.

title: Republic of Sahtu
source_claim_or_role: Only occurrence is a temporal comparison to life before the Flood; causal dependence is not established by the hit.
proposed_disposition: Do not retcon solely on this phrase; inspect the full independence and population narrative before deciding.

title: Association of East-Asia
source_claim_or_role: States that the Flood left hundreds of millions homeless and displaced; links this to the regional order.
proposed_disposition: Remove unsupported displacement scale and reconstruct East Asian political/economic order from independent regional drivers.

title: Australia
source_claim_or_role: Flood is said to cause severe drought and render the interior virtually uninhabitable, with major coastal-city impacts.
proposed_disposition: Retain only region-specific drought, heat, water and coastal risks with defensible magnitudes; remove global Flood label.

title: Great Famine
source_claim_or_role: The 2027 famine is explicitly attributed to the Flood, desalination, land loss and port destruction.
proposed_disposition: Remove global famine and extraordinary mortality; retain separate regional food-security crises with proximate causes and defined accounting.

title: Notable Literature
source_claim_or_role: Literature is organized around the Flood; the 2031 American Empire book premise depends on the event.
proposed_disposition: Review named works and their historical premises; retitle/reframe only those whose subject matter depends on the retired event.

title: Generational Chaos
source_claim_or_role: The Flood is listed as a Fourth Turning crisis alongside other historical events.
proposed_disposition: Remove it from the cycle or replace with a plausible, separately grounded crisis; reassess the generational chronology.

title: Third Agricultural Revolution
source_claim_or_role: Agricultural technology transfer and adoption are described as occurring during the Flood and increasing production.
proposed_disposition: Potentially retain the agricultural transition, but ground it in food prices, drought, R&D, regulation and supply-chain pressures rather than global catastrophe.

title: People's Republic of China
source_claim_or_role: Second Civil War section ties coastal loss, >100m inland displacement, famine and Three Gorges Dam failure to rebellion.
proposed_disposition: Remove this civil-war chain under the timeline; rebuild Chinese political risks without a catastrophic dam or Flood-driven displacement.

title: American Empire
source_claim_or_role: The geopolitical book's central thesis explicitly derives from the Flood making the US an 'unintentional empire'.
proposed_disposition: If the book remains, rewrite its thesis around plausible strategic/economic developments; preserve as a fictional work only if premise changes.

title: The Great Deluge
source_claim_or_role: A scientific/sociological book analyzes the Flood and informs EWG goals.
proposed_disposition: Remove or reframe the book and its claimed policy influence if the event is retired.

title: Sovereign Citizen's Alliance
source_claim_or_role: The infobox places the entity's era within the Flood; the state/insurgency timeline sits in the crisis period.
proposed_disposition: Remove the Flood era marker; assess the faction's existence and scale independently under the bounded-extremism rule.

title: Brazil
source_claim_or_role: Flood and Great Famine intensify opposition to Bolsonaro and precede rebellion/coup.
proposed_disposition: Rebuild political rupture from Brazilian institutions, land conflict, fiscal conditions, election dynamics and military incentives.

title: Europans
source_claim_or_role: Moon colonization is said to arise from water demand during the Flood.
proposed_disposition: Remove the Flood-driven lunar settlement rationale; any lunar settlement needs independent economics, transport and life-support feasibility.

title: Neo-Jeffersonianism
source_claim_or_role: Political ideology is partly explained as a reaction by the Flood Generation to postwar economic exclusion.
proposed_disposition: Reframe the cohort and causal story around a defensible generational marker and labor-market conditions.

title: Venezuela
source_claim_or_role: Sea-level displacement and Great Famine are tied to refugee camps and regime-changing social revolution.
proposed_disposition: Remove extreme displacement/famine chain; retain independently grounded coastal, economic, food and governance pressures.

title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
source_claim_or_role: Future presidency and Renewal narrative place AOC at the center of the Flood, economic crisis and refugee-policy response.
proposed_disposition: Preserve observed biography; future election/presidency is optional fiction and must not be treated as required; remove Flood-dependent future claims.

title: White Tide
source_claim_or_role: Flood diverts federal attention/resources from extremists and shapes political cooperation; war displacement is layered on top.
proposed_disposition: Apply bounded-extremism retcon; remove Flood as explanation for state capacity, mobilization and mass displacement.

title: Latvia
source_claim_or_role: Europe's collapse and Polish annexation are linked to the Flood and retreating sea levels.
proposed_disposition: Remove the continental Flood-collapse and sea-level retreat chain; independently ground any later Baltic realignment.

title: 2060s
source_claim_or_role: Decade's recovery is attributed to the Flood through global cooling and sea-level reversal by 2066.
proposed_disposition: Post-2041 divergence is allowed, but the physical mechanism is not credible; remove the global Refreeze or explicitly bound the later divergence.

title: Prime Minister of Canada
source_claim_or_role: Flood-related problems are cited in Canada's emergency government and 2029 transition to a republic.
proposed_disposition: Re-ground constitutional change in Canadian political and constitutional developments; remove Flood as proximate cause.

title: American Redoubt
source_claim_or_role: Infobox labels the entity's era as the Flood; its secessionist timeline overlaps the White Tide crisis.
proposed_disposition: Remove the Flood era marker and reconcile with the bounded White Tide/extremism scale.
